comment: Independent witness for three callers of dungeon.c level_difficulty() on a dungeon -1 level: do.c goto_level()'s Tourist more_experienced(), read.c create_particular()'s rndmonst() for #wizgenesis "*", and read.c do_genocide()'s rndmonst() for a reverse genocide answered "none". A Tourist improvises once on a wished wooden flute (a one-note tune), wishes for a magic portal, which keeps maketrap()'s dst of {-1, -1}, and steps back onto it, arriving on a level of dungeon -1. At each call builds_up() finds no branch for dungeon -1 and calls impossible(), with three --More-- prompts. Seed, date, role and inputs chosen independently.
